finding.claim: ROUTING always says 'Start at .okf/summary.md', even when the bundle has no summary.md. That happens in every project made before this change that moves its pin to this release (ADR 0026) and has not run kmctl update yet: the briefing sends the agent to a missing file at every session start, while the CLAUDE.md block still says .okf/index.md. render already knows whether a summary exists (summary_behind is None when there is none), so it can fall back to .okf/index.md.

fixes.change: ROUTING says Start at .okf/index.md when there is no .okf/summary.md
a briefing without a summary starts at the index; the seeded-files test copies summary.md
